combo.description: Use your E over a wall and then as you're traveling press your W and your R! Then use your Q, Q, Q and AA to finish.
Use your W over a wall and E and R over to your target. Then Q, AA, Q, Q, Q and a final AA to finish.
Start with your R then Q, AA, E and AA. Now Q, Q, and Q before another AA and finish with your W.
Use your Q then E and R. Then Q, Q, Q, AA and Q again to Finish.
Use your Q then AA. E into the wall then Q and AA again.
Use your E and W over a wall then Q, Q, Q and AA to finish.
Use your Q then AA, W, AA Q and AA again to finish.
Use your Q and AA, then E, W and Q before another AA and finish with your Q.
